values.note: Campspot, one night for 2 adults in June and July 2027: RV sites with power and water (30 A; trail-view pull-throughs, one 50 A) C$35 plus 5% tax and a C$3 booking fee. Power-only RV sites (C$25 + fee) are not open to motorhomes; unserviced tent sites C$20 + fee. Cancellation 7+ days out refunds less a C$10 admin fee; 3-7 days, 50%.

fees.source: Campspot https://www.campspot.com/book/irricanacampground (park record, site types and checkout quotes for one night 2027-06-08 and 2027-07-13, 2 adults; read 2026-11-10): RV Site (Power + Water) and RV Site-Trail View (Power + Water) quotes 'base 35.0 tax 1.75' plus 'Booking Fee 3.0'; list prices RV Site (Power Only) 28.0 (power-only sites' rvTypes exclude Motorhome), Tent Site (Unserviced) 23.0; policy 'Cancellation notice received 1 week (7 days) or more prior to arrival date; a full refund will be issued less a $10.00 admin fee.'

values.note: 2026: open May 14 to September 27, then dry camping September 28 to October 12 by email booking (the town's March 2026 post said May 14 to September 13).

season.source: Town of Irricana Community Information page, 'Municipal Campground' tab https://townofirricana.ca/community-information/ (read 2026-11-10): 'Open May 14-Sept. 27th, 2026 (Book Online) Dry Camping Sept. 28th-Oct. 12th, 2026 (Book by emailing campground@irricana.com )'; Town of Irricana post 'Irricana Campground-2026 Season' (2026-03-20) https://townofirricana.ca/campground-2026-season/ (read 2026-11-10): 'The Campground is open from May 14-September 13, 2026'

values.note: All bookings online and ahead of arrival; dry camping after the main season is booked by email. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: Town of Irricana Community Information page, 'Municipal Campground' tab https://townofirricana.ca/community-information/ (read 2026-11-10): 'All Campground reservations are made online and all bookings must be made ahead of arriving on-site.'; Town of Irricana post 'Irricana Campground-2026 Season' (2026-03-20) https://townofirricana.ca/campground-2026-season/ (read 2026-11-10): 'All reservations are made online and are required prior to arriving on-site.'; Campspot https://www.campspot.com/book/irricanacampground (park record, site types and checkout quotes for one night 2027-06-08 and 2027-07-13, 2 adults; read 2026-11-10): checkinTime '2:00pm', checkoutTime '11:00am'

sites.source: Campspot https://www.campspot.com/book/irricanacampground (park record, site types and checkout quotes for one night 2027-06-08 and 2027-07-13, 2 adults; read 2026-11-10): 'RV Site (Power + Water)' 27 sites (rvLengthMax 24-50), 'RV Site-Trail View (Power + Water)' 6 sites (30-50, 5 Pull-Through), 'RV Site (Power Only)' 3 sites

hookups.source: Campspot https://www.campspot.com/book/irricanacampground (park record, site types and checkout quotes for one night 2027-06-08 and 2027-07-13, 2 adults; read 2026-11-10): RV Site-Trail View description '30-amp power (Site 35 has 50-amp power) along with a convenient water hookup'; amenities '30-Amp', '50-Amp', 'Water Hook-Up'

facilities.source: Campspot https://www.campspot.com/book/irricanacampground (park record, site types and checkout quotes for one night 2027-06-08 and 2027-07-13, 2 adults; read 2026-11-10): parkFeatures 'Bathrooms', 'Dump Station', 'Showers'; Town of Irricana post 'Irricana Campground-2026 Season' (2026-03-20) https://townofirricana.ca/campground-2026-season/ (read 2026-11-10): 'Showers + washrooms'

note: Town of Irricana campground at Founders Park, across from the Pioneer Acres Museum, with an on-site manager, a rentable outdoor camp kitchen, group tent sites and walking trails. --Claude
summary: Owned and managed by the Town of Irricana (confirmed local). Priced on Campspot (2027): C$35 power+water RV sites + 5% tax + C$3 booking fee (no rate stored before). 36 RV sites (27 power+water, 6 trail-view incl. 5 pull-throughs and the 50 A site 35, 3 power-only not open to motorhomes). 2026 season May 14 - Sep 27 + dry camping to Oct 12. Wrote fees, season, booking (Campspot, online only), sites, hookups, facilities; note trimmed (Camp Reservations Canada line obsolete).
